inputs.original_text: ISRAEL’S parliament began a debate today on a Bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The Bill’s passage would be a victory for Israel’s far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Opponents of the legislation call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up. They want you to look at the surface and think this is just a normal political debate in Israel’s parliament about a Bill for the death penalty as the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. That’s just the script they are feeding the public to keep everyone distracted from the real choreography. 

Look at who benefits: it's a total victory for Itamar Ben-Gvir, the far-right Minister of National Security and leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Don't believe for a second that the opposition is actually standing against them. When opponents call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants, that is just controlled opposition playing their assigned roles in this theater to make you think there's a real struggle happening behind closed doors. It's all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites pulling the strings.
